newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to review taxes in financial system -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to review taxes in financial system -- MOF.

text.p: Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa said on Monday that taxes related to Japan's financial system will be reviewed as part of discussions over the reform of Japan's tax system.
"The tax system related to the financial system should also be discussed in the context of general tax reform," Ogawa told reporters.

Ogawa said he told the various advisory panels in the ministry currently discussing reforms for Japan's financial system to proceed as swiftly as possible, as requested by Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto.
